description.html: HabiStat Leopard Gecko Bedding is a substrate designed to mimic the dry, hilly woodland habitats leopard geckos come from. The blend of sand, clay and soil is natural, gives a firm surface to walk on (leopard geckos have no sticky toe pads) and encourages natural digging.

The substrate comes slightly pre-moistened and absorbs water, so the spots you mist turn into damper zones, similar to the humid hides and burrows geckos look for when shedding. It is ready to use straight from the bag and is packed in a recyclable paper bag.

items: Spread the substrate evenly across the terrarium floor in a layer of 5 to 7.5 cm.
If you use a heat mat under the floor, do not make the layer too deep.
The manufacturer recommends fully replacing or refreshing the substrate every 12 months.

description.html: Besides leopard geckos, it also suits other desert species that need dry ground they can dig in. The 10 kg bag suits larger terrariums or several changes. Learn how to equip the whole setup in our leopard gecko terrarium guide.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
